accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding suicides in the farm sector according to NCRB ADSI 2024:

accepted.s:

accepted.s:

accepted.s: Under Section 309 of the Indian Penal Code, attempt to suicide was punishable with
o: Imprisonment up to six months only
Imprisonment up to one year and/or fine
Imprisonment up to three years without fine
accepted.x: Section 309 IPC provided punishment of imprisonment up to one year and/or a fine for attempted suicide.
accepted.tq: Recall the exact statutory punishment and watch for the shortened-period trap.
accepted.sec: Attempt to suicide in law - IPC 309, Mental Healthcare Act 2017, Tele-MANAS

accepted.s: Which case held Section 309 IPC invalid before the position was overruled by Gian Kaur?
accepted.x: P. Rathinam, decided in 1994, held Section 309 invalid; Gian Kaur in 1996 overruled that position.
accepted.tq: Match the judicial holding with the correct case name and year sequence.
accepted.sec: Attempt to suicide in law - IPC 309, Mental Healthcare Act 2017, Tele-MANAS

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly states the position associated with Gian Kaur (1996)?
o: There is no right to die, but there is a right to die with dignity.
There is an absolute right to die under Article 21.
Attempted suicide must always be punished under Section 309 IPC.
Section 309 IPC was declared unconstitutional without qualification.
accepted.x: Gian Kaur overruled P. Rathinam and stated that there is no right to die, though there is a right to die with dignity.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between the right to die and the right to die with dignity.
accepted.sec: Attempt to suicide in law - IPC 309, Mental Healthcare Act 2017, Tele-MANAS

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about Section 115 of the Mental Healthcare Act, 2017:
1. It presumes that a person attempting suicide was under severe stress.
2. It removes trial or punishment for such an attempt.
3. It requires the State to provide care, treatment and rehabilitation.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Section 115 presumes severe stress, prevents trial or punishment for the attempt, and places a duty on the State to provide care.
accepted.tq: Test the combined legal presumption, consequence and State duty.
accepted.sec: Attempt to suicide in law - IPC 309, Mental Healthcare Act 2017, Tele-MANAS

accepted.s: Under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, the provision relating to attempt to suicide applies specifically when the attempt is made to

accepted.x: The BNS 2023 contains no general offence of attempted suicide; Section 226 covers an attempt made to coerce a public servant.
accepted.tq: Distinguish a general offence from the specific statutory exception.
